Chiefs vs Seahawks DraftKings Showdown Picks: Sunday Night Football NFL DFS Captains, Projections and Sim Plays

DraftKings Showdown · Sunday Night Football, October 25 · NFL Week 7 · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of October 25, 7:35 PM ET

Kenneth Walker III has the highest SPAGS projection in the Chiefs at Seahawks DraftKings Showdown: 22.0 points at $12,000 FLEX, 33.0 at captain for $18,000. Across 100,000 simulations Walker holds 66% of the winning-lineup credit. The case against Walker is his range, not his role: a simulated floor of 8.8 points at a $12,000 FLEX salary, in a game with a 43.5-point total.

He also has the largest captain share: 24.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit comes with Walker at captain. Jaxon Smith-Njigba is the next captain in line, at 21.1%. The model gives him 9.4 targets on 26.9 routes.

Seattle is a 3-point favorite, and the implied totals are 23.25 for the Seahawks and 20.25 for the Chiefs.

Behind Walker and Smith-Njigba, the next projections are Patrick Mahomes (17.1, $10,400), Sam Darnold (16.0, $9,400) and Emanuel Wilson (12.6, $6,400).

Every projection below is a SPAGS model estimate from the October 25, 7:35 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. Winning-lineup and captain credit come from 100,000 simulations of the Showdown contest, and tied winning entries share credit. A player's simulated floor is his 10th-percentile score and his ceiling is his 95th. Showdown lineups use one captain, who scores 1.5x at 1.5x salary, and five FLEX players.

Chris Spags' latest NFL DFS breakdown on the Splash Play NFL channel.

SNF Showdown captain picks: who the sim wins with

Captain: Kenneth Walker III, KC RB ($12,000 FLEX / $18,000 CPT)

Kenneth Walker III holds 24.6% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain, more than any other player in this game. At captain he costs $18,000 and the 22.0-point SPAGS model projection becomes 33.0 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 18.2 carries and 4.4 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Walker averaged 22.0 points with a simulated floor of 8.8 and a ceiling of 42.5. He holds 66% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 24.6% as the captain and 41.8% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Jaxon Smith-Njigba, SEA WR ($11,600 FLEX / $17,400 CPT)

Jaxon Smith-Njigba holds 21.1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $17,400 and the 21.2-point SPAGS model projection becomes 31.8 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model gives him 9.4 targets on 26.9 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Smith-Njigba averaged 21.2 points with a simulated floor of 7.8 and a ceiling of 46.5. He holds 61% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 21.1% as the captain and 40.0% in a FLEX spot.

Captain: Patrick Mahomes, KC QB ($10,400 FLEX / $15,600 CPT)

Patrick Mahomes holds 11.0% of the simulated winning-lineup credit as a captain. At captain he costs $15,600 and the 17.1-point SPAGS model projection becomes 25.6 with the 1.5x captain multiplier. The model includes 3.3 rushing attempts. Across 100,000 simulations Mahomes averaged 17.1 points with a simulated floor of 5.8 and a ceiling of 34.7. He holds 53% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 11.0% as the captain and 42.3% in a FLEX spot.

Top FLEX projections for Chiefs vs Seahawks

Sam Darnold, SEA QB ($9,400 FLEX / $14,100 CPT)

Sam Darnold carries the 4th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 16.0 DraftKings points for a $9,400 FLEX salary ($14,100 at captain). Across 100,000 simulations Darnold averaged 16.0 points with a simulated floor of 5.4 and a ceiling of 32.6. He holds 52% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 8.0% as the captain and 43.8% in a FLEX spot.

Emanuel Wilson, SEA RB ($6,400 FLEX / $9,600 CPT)

Emanuel Wilson carries the 5th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.6 DraftKings points for a $6,400 FLEX salary ($9,600 at captain). The model gives him 17.7 carries and 1.2 targets. Across 100,000 simulations Wilson averaged 12.6 points with a simulated floor of 3.7 and a ceiling of 27.7. He holds 46% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 9.4% as the captain and 36.7% in a FLEX spot.

Travis Kelce carries the 6th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 12.3 DraftKings points for an $8,000 FLEX salary ($12,000 at captain). The model gives him 6.5 targets on 25.8 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Kelce averaged 12.3 points with a simulated floor of 3.7 and a ceiling of 27.6. Xavier Worthy, KC WR ($7,000 FLEX / $10,500 CPT)

Xavier Worthy carries the 7th-highest SPAGS model projection in the game at 11.4 DraftKings points for a $7,000 FLEX salary ($10,500 at captain). The model gives him 6.8 targets on 28.6 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Worthy averaged 11.4 points with a simulated floor of 4.6 and a ceiling of 24.0. He holds 38% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.0% as the captain and 34.0% in a FLEX spot.

Value: Jalen Royals, KC WR ($3,400 FLEX / $5,100 CPT)

Jalen Royals projects for 5.7 DraftKings points at a $3,400 FLEX salary, 1.66 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 2.8 targets on 14.1 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Royals averaged 5.6 points with a simulated floor of 0.0 and a ceiling of 15.0. He holds 20% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 0.8% as the captain and 18.7% in a FLEX spot.

Value: AJ Barner, SEA TE ($4,600 FLEX / $6,900 CPT)

AJ Barner projects for 7.7 DraftKings points at a $4,600 FLEX salary, 1.66 projected points per $1,000. The model gives him 4.0 targets on 22.7 routes. Across 100,000 simulations Barner averaged 7.7 points with a simulated floor of 0.4 and a ceiling of 23.5. He holds 26% of the simulated winning-lineup credit: 4.4% as the captain and 21.6% in a FLEX spot.

Who is the best captain for the Chiefs vs Seahawks DraftKings Showdown?

Kenneth Walker III holds the largest captain share of simulated winning lineups at 24.6%, ahead of Jaxon Smith-Njigba (21.1%) and Patrick Mahomes (11.0%), across 100,000 simulations.

What is the best DraftKings Showdown lineup for Chiefs vs Seahawks?

Build around Jaxon Smith-Njigba at captain with Sam Darnold, Emanuel Wilson and Xavier Worthy at FLEX. That is the core of the lineup that won the most simulations in Chris Spags' pool (163 of 100,000 simulated contests), and it leaves $9,800 for the last two FLEX spots.

Who has the highest projection in Chiefs vs Seahawks DraftKings Showdown?

Kenneth Walker III leads the SPAGS model at 22.0 DraftKings points for $12,000 at FLEX, or 33.0 points at captain for $18,000.

What are the DraftKings salaries for Chiefs vs Seahawks Showdown?

Kenneth Walker III is the most expensive player at $12,000 FLEX and $18,000 at captain. All 30 players with a SPAGS projection are listed above with FLEX salary, captain salary and projection.

What are the best value plays in Chiefs vs Seahawks DraftKings Showdown?

At $5,000 and under, the best projected points per $1,000 belong to Jalen Royals (5.7 points at $3,400), AJ Barner (7.7 points at $4,600) and Harrison Butker (7.8 points at $4,800).

What is the Chiefs vs Seahawks spread and total?

The Seahawks are a 3-point favorite in a game totaled at 43.5, with implied team totals of 23.25 for the Seahawks and 20.25 for the Chiefs.
